# GitHub Repository Metadata & Search Topics

This document specifies the official repository metadata, description, topics, and search optimization parameters for [MatinBodaghi/repotrim](https://github.com/MatinBodaghi/repotrim).

---

## 1. Repository Description

```text
Mathematically optimal codebase context trimmer for AI coding agents under token budgets (Model Context Protocol, Personalized PageRank, CELF Knapsack, Tree-sitter).
```

- **Website / Documentation URL:** `https://docs.rs/repotrim`
- **Include in home page:** Checked

## 3. GitHub CLI Application Command

To synchronize these topics directly via the GitHub CLI:

```bash
gh repo edit MatinBodaghi/repotrim \
  --description "Mathematically optimal codebase context trimmer for AI coding agents under token budgets (Model Context Protocol, Personalized PageRank, CELF Knapsack, Tree-sitter)." \
  --homepage "https://docs.rs/repotrim" \
  --add-topic "model-context-protocol" \
  --add-topic "mcp" \
  --add-topic "llm" \
  --add-topic "context-optimization" \
  --add-topic "ai-agents" \
  --add-topic "code-analysis" \
  --add-topic "tree-sitter" \
  --add-topic "submodular-optimization" \
  --add-topic "pagerank" \
  --add-topic "rust" \
  --add-topic "cursor" \
  --add-topic "windsurf" \
  --add-topic "claude-desktop" \
  --add-topic "claude-code" \
  --add-topic "token-optimization"
```
